paragraphs: Lendable’s ambition to deliver instant credit and savings solutions mirrors my work on a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, where I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) and presented it in a live stakeholder demo.

I wrote a three‑tier test framework (tool‑level, API/integration, live agent) of ~65 tests across 8 files, validated across the LLM provider migration from Groq to AWS Bedrock after a rate‑limit evaluation.
